title: Applicant Landlord: Thomas Horan – Respondent Tenant:Shawna Maher
text:
Residential Tenancies Board

Determination Order

Ref: DR1017-38020

In the matter of Thomas Horan [Applicant Landlord] and Shawna Maher [Respondent
Tenant] the Residential Tenancies Board, in accordance with section 121 of the Residential
Tenancies Act 2004, determines that:

1.

The Notice of Termination served on 13 September 2017, by the Applicant Landlord
on the Respondent Tenant, in respect of the tenancy of the dwelling known as
Apartment 10, 5 Cabra Park, Dublin 7 is valid.

The Respondent Tenant and all persons residing in the above dwelling, shall vacate
and give up possession of the dwelling within 21 days of the date of issue of this
Order.

The Respondent Tenant shall pay the total sum of €1,613.12 to the Applicant
Landlord, in 10 consecutive monthly payments of €160.00, on the 28th day of each
month, commencing on the 28th day of the month immediately following the date of
issue of this Order, being rent arrears of €1,613.12 which includes late fees and
admin charges of €150.00 in respect of the tenancy of the above dwelling.

The Respondent Tenant shall pay any further rent outstanding to the Applicant
Landlord from the 7th November 2017, being the date of the Adjudication hearing, at
the rate of €1,100.00 per month or proportionate part thereof at the rate of €36.16 per
day, unless lawfully varied, and any other charges as set out in the terms of the
tenancy agreement for each month or part thereof, until such time as the above
dwelling is vacated by the Respondent Tenant and all persons residing therein.

The enforcement of this Order for such payment of €1,613.12 will be deferred and
the total sum owing will be reduced by the cumulative sum paid in the monthly
instalments made by the Respondent Tenant to the Applicant Landlord on each due
date until such time as the total sum of €1,613.12 has been paid in full.

For the avoidance of doubt, any default in the payment of any monthly instalment
shall act to cancel any further deferral and the balance due at the date of default of
any such monthly payment shall immediately become due and owing to the Applicant
Landlord.

This Order was made by the Residential Tenancies Board o 45 December 2017.

We cK GO

Paddy Gray (JY Carolyn O’Brien
Board Member Higher Executive Officer
